scope: Read-only audit of diagnose_agent_capability.py and predeclared probes/plan.json; no new model or robot calls.
important_confounds: Vertical flip changes the real button down-arrow symbol into an up-arrow while raw-flip prompt still names DOWN-CALL. Raw-flip failures/unknown cannot uniquely diagnose spatial reversal failure. T/P marked flips explicitly compare annotations and avoid this referent ambiguity.

presence_report_correct checks only yes/yes. It is affirmative-presence reporting, not proven object identification or fine localization accuracy; no predicted location is scored. Uncertain physical-tip identity is not necessarily an object-recognition error.
relation_correct is answer-label match conditional on assistant-reviewed approximate references, not contact calibration or robotics control correctness.
Crop/enlarge changes resolution, field of view, context and distractors together. Neither success nor failure isolates resolution alone.
T/P marks inject approximate referent locations and salient colored cues. Improved results support ability under externally grounded references, not a unique neural mechanism.
Two difficult source images and one repeat each do not estimate general success rate or stochastic stability; correlated transformations are not independent scenes.
scope_supported: Text-coordinate comparison separate from natural-object grounding.
Marked-point image relation separate from natural reference identification.
Sticker-center vs physical-tip reference wording sensitivity on the same raw pixels.
Exact repeated request consistency for two observations.
scope_not_supported: General 3D spatial understanding, hand-eye transform, mm magnitude, contact or closed-loop task success.
Causal attribution to model quantization, visual encoder, pretraining coverage, attention or reasoning layers.
